description.description: A series of four video frames showing a large crowd of people gathered in an outdoor urban setting. In the first frame, people are congested behind metal barricades with a traffic light visible in the background. The second and third frames show a disruption, where individuals are seen pulling or moving a metal barricade as a crowd gathers around. In the final frame, an individual in a grey uniform appears to be adjusting or holding a metal barricade, with observers nearby.
